DELIVERABLE: (1) Replace any duplicate Appearance persistence flow in `SettingsDialog` with the canonical `appearanceSettings` API so changed theme/accent/density persists and applies through the runtime bridge across remount/restart. (6) Make General non-empty with useful content that does not duplicate Appearance settings; a concise navigation/overview card is acceptable.
SCOPE: You may edit ONLY `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`, `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx`, `ui/src/lib/settingsRuntime.test.ts`, and directly related small settings test files you create. Do NOT edit `App.tsx`, `main.tsx`, native Rust, remote frontend, shared storage keys used outside Quick Commands, or docs.
VERIFY: Use failing-first tests: add cases for Appearance remount persistence, PIN clipboard copy + feedback, restart-policy copy, Default Agent semantics, no Quick Commands navigation/section, and non-empty General. STOP WHEN: All six behaviors are implemented in your scope with RED→GREEN focused Vitest proof and a concise report of files/tests. Do not make commits.
